subject: or_legislature/2025R1/HB3272
title: Requires a public institution of higher education to award academic credit when an enrolled student completed a high school class or participated in a high school program that offered learning and experiences comparable to an introductory communications, public speaking or argumentation course offered at the institution.
headline: HB 3272 did not pass

claims.text: HB 3272 was introduced in the House on January 21, 2025.
HB 3272 was still in a House committee when the session ended. Last recorded step: June 27, 2025.
Each of the 3 recorded steps was checked against Oregon's chamber procedure and every move was a legal one.
